record.bible_text: <FO><FO>To the chief Musician<WH05329><WTH8764>, A Psalm<WH04210> for the sons<WH01121> of Korah<WH07141>.<Fo><Fo> LORD<WH03068>, thou hast been favourable<WH07521><WTH8804> unto thy land<WH0776>: thou hast brought back<WH07725><WTH8804> the captivity<WH07622><WTH8675><WH07622> of Jacob<WH03290>. <RF>for the sons: or, of the sons<Rf> <RF>favourable: or, well pleased<Rf>
Thou hast forgiven<WH05375><WTH8804> the iniquity<WH05771> of thy people<WH05971>, thou hast covered<WH03680><WTH8765> all their sin<WH02403>. Selah<WH05542>.

Thou hast taken away<WH0622><WTH8804> all thy wrath<WH05678>: thou hast turned<WH07725><WTH8689> <FI>thyself<Fi> from the fierceness<WH02740> of thine anger<WH0639>. <RF>thyself...: or, thine anger from waxing hot<Rf>
Turn<WH07725><WTH8798> us, O God<WH0430> of our salvation<WH03468>, and cause thine anger<WH03708> toward us to cease<WH06565><WTH8685>.
Wilt thou be angry<WH0599><WTH8799> with us for ever<WH05769>? wilt thou draw out<WH04900><WTH8799> thine anger<WH0639> to all<WH01755> generations<WH01755>?
Wilt thou not revive<WH02421><WTH8762> us again<WH07725><WTH8799>: that thy people<WH05971> may rejoice<WH08055><WTH8799> in thee?
Shew<WH07200><WTH8685> us thy mercy<WH02617>, O LORD<WH03068>, and grant<WH05414><WTH8799> us thy salvation<WH03468>.<CM>

I will hear<WH08085><WTH8799> what God<WH0410> the LORD<WH03068> will speak<WH01696><WTH8762>: for he will speak<WH01696><WTH8762> peace<WH07965> unto his people<WH05971>, and to his saints<WH02623>: but let them not turn again<WH07725><WTH8799> to folly<WH03690>.
Surely his salvation<WH03468> <FI>is<Fi> nigh<WH07138> them that fear<WH03373> him; that glory<WH03519> may dwell<WH07931><WTH8800> in our land<WH0776>.
Mercy<WH02617> and truth<WH0571> are met together<WH06298><WTH8738>; righteousness<WH06664> and peace<WH07965> have kissed<WH05401><WTH8804> <FI>each other<Fi> .
Truth<WH0571> shall spring out<WH06779><WTH8799> of the earth<WH0776>; and righteousness<WH06664> shall look down<WH08259><WTH8738> from heaven<WH08064>.
Yea, the LORD<WH03068> shall give<WH05414><WTH8799> <FI>that which is<Fi> good<WH02896>; and our land<WH0776> shall yield<WH05414><WTH8799> her increase<WH02981>.
Righteousness<WH06664> shall go<WH01980><WTH8762> before<WH06440> him; and shall set<WH07760><WTH8799> <FI>us<Fi> in the way<WH01870> of his steps<WH06471>.<CM>
